entries.title: Genesis 13:1
segments: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, (and Lot was with him) into the south.

entries.title: Genesis 13:2
segments: And Abram [was] very rich in cattle, in silver and in gold.

entries.title: Genesis 13:3
segments: And he went on his journeys from the south, even to Bethel, to the place where his tent had been from the beginning, between Bethel and Hai,

entries.title: Genesis 13:4
segments: to the place of the altar which he had made there at the first. And Abram called on the name of the LORD there.

entries.title: Genesis 13:5
segments: And Lot, who went with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.

entries.title: Genesis 13:6
segments: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might live together. For their substance was great, so that they could not live together.

entries.title: Genesis 13:7
segments: And there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram's cattle and the herdsmen of Lot's cattle. And the Canaanite and the Perizzite lived then in the land.

entries.title: Genesis 13:8
segments: And Abram said to Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray you, between me and you, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen; for we [are] men, brothers.

entries.title: Genesis 13:9
segments: [Is] not the whole land before you? I pray you, separate yourself from me. If [you go] to the left, then I will go to the right. Or if [you go] to the right, then I will go to the left.

entries.title: Genesis 13:10
segments: And Lot lifted up his eyes and saw all the circuit of Jordan, that it [was] all well watered (before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah,) like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt as you come to Zoar.

entries.title: Genesis 13:11
segments: And Lot chose all the circuit of Jordan for himself. And Lot journeyed east; and they separated themselves from one another.

entries.title: Genesis 13:12
segments: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the circuit and pitched [his] tent toward Sodom.

entries.title: Genesis 13:13
segments: But the men of Sodom [were] wicked and sinners before the LORD, exceedingly so.

entries.title: Genesis 13:14
segments: And after Lot was separated from him, the LORD said to Abram, Lift up your eyes now and look from the place where you are northward and southward, and eastward and westward.

entries.title: Genesis 13:15
segments: For all the land which you see I will give to you, and to your seed forever.

entries.title: Genesis 13:16
segments: And I will make your seed as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then shall your seed also be counted.

entries.title: Genesis 13:17
segments: Rise up and walk through the land, in the length of it and in the breadth of it, for I will give it to you.

entries.title: Genesis 13:18
segments: And Abram moved [his] tent and came and lived in the oaks of Mamre, which [is] in Hebron. And he built an altar to the LORD there.
